messages:
maria (Product Ops): Quick heads-up — we're opening a limited preview for a new Dedicated pool: 'RTX-7000 Edge' in London (eu-west-2) and Nairobi (africa-north-1). Target workloads: low-latency edge inference with 48GB cards, optimized for quantized models. Preview start: 2026-04-06 00:00 UTC. This round is invite-only: priority customers + reserved migrations. See notes below.

jake (Capacity PM): Launch details:
- initial capacity: 16 GPUs in LON, 8 GPUs in NBO.
- burst windows: 08:00–22:00 local time (to preserve cross-region capacity).
- pricing: ~10% premium vs standard dedicated A100x due to infra footprint.
- reservations: preview accepts short-term reservations only (30d min).
CLI example: `rw capacity reserve create --pool rtx7000-edge --region eu-west-2 --gpus 4 --term 30d`

ana (Sales Eng): We'll surface a one-time migration credit for customers moving from H100 spots to this pool — coordinating lists now and will DM affected AEs.

leo (SRE): Any perf caveats to call out?
jake (Capacity PM): Bench highlights: 8k-context throughput optimized; first-request KV cache warmup adds ~5–10ms on cold starts. Quantized kernels enabled by default; large-batch latencies are competitive. We noticed slightly higher tail latencies under sustained >80% util, so auto-fallbacks to compatible pools are configured.

sre-bot: Capacity monitor: projected headroom week1 -> LON: 12% free, NBO: 28% free. Auto-escalation at sustained 70% utilization.

ana (Sales Eng): Clarify: preview availability is for Dedicated Reserved customers only, right? Not routed to Hosted API?
jake (Capacity PM): Correct for preview: Reserved Dedicated only. We will map a hosted-compatible model route after GA with a soft-limit during the first month.

maria (Product Ops): Action items: 
- PMs: update model-catalog mappings by Thu EOD.
- Eng: add runbook for KV cache warmups and fallback policy.
- Support: publish KB + migration checklist before invites go out.
- Sales: coordinate customer invite emails by Fri EOD.
Ping me if you need docs or help with messaging.

leo (SRE): +1, adding runbook entry now.
jake (Capacity PM): For infra folks: deployment tag is `rtx7000-edge-v1` — rolling deploy completed in eu-west-2, NBO deploy scheduled 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC.

sre-bot: Deploy status: eu-west-2 rollout succeeded (16/16 nodes), africa-north-1 scheduled.

ana (Sales Eng): :party: Nice — I'll draft the customer invite template and share in #sales.
maria (Product Ops): Links: perf deck + checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/rtx7000-edge-preview (internal).
